issue.body:
Is there a way to extract the total number of in-flight requests (i.e. the number of requests that have been received and not yet responded to)?

If so, how can it be consumed? E.g. can I create an endpoint like /requests which responds with the number? Or perhaps a cron task which can query the number so I could send it to a stats database?

For context, I'd like to trigger autoscaling events based on the number of in-flight requests.
issue.title: Is it possible to extract the number of in-flight requests?
